name: gradient-button-group
blurb: Navigation button group with animated gold ring and theme toggle.
description: A Framer Motion-powered button group with layered inset effects, spinning gold gradient ring on active state, and an integrated theme toggle.
use_when: You need a sophisticated navigation component with visual depth and theme switching.
avoid_when: On simpler interfaces where visual complexity is undesirable.
a11y: aria-label on each nav button; aria-current='page' on active. Theme toggle has aria-label. Icons are aria-hidden.
